candidates.title: A causal connector predicts a dependent downstream state
candidates.prediction: Candidate-bearing links yield downstream states conditionally dependent on preceding events; a simple sequence model predicts no dependency interaction.
candidates.countermodel: Record position and ordinary action-to-state ordering explain the apparent dependency.
candidates.available: Existing event/transition reports are structural only; no independent causal gold is available.
candidates.next_source_check: Audit exact event relation definitions in experiments/yolo/gdt344_grammar_transition_paths/REPORT.md and separate source-attested relations from analyst causal labels.

candidates.title: A contrast marker selects between explicitly opposed alternatives
candidates.prediction: Candidate contexts contain predeclared mutually exclusive alternatives with polarity reversal; a generic connector predicts no alternative interaction.
candidates.countermodel: Apparent alternatives are merely adjacent fields or analyst-imposed oppositions.
candidates.available: No candidate-specific independent opposition gold identified; navigation returned unrelated marker/alternative histories only.
candidates.next_source_check: Inspect one bounded primary report for authored OR/versus alternatives and require a fixed opposition rubric before candidate selection.

candidates.title: A coordination marker scopes over a multi-item list
candidates.prediction: Candidate contexts group multiple independently typed items under one shared predicate; an item-noun model predicts independent predicates instead.
candidates.countermodel: List grouping is a segmentation artifact or quantity/adjacency effect.
candidates.available: Existing field/record reports provide sequences but no independent coordination-scope gold for this candidate.
candidates.next_source_check: Check GDT709/GDT756 primary definitions for authored shared-predicate/list alternatives; do not treat parser grouping as semantic evidence.
